# Pulsus Tech

> Technology risk software: applications, infrastructure, vendors, end-of-support dates, incidents and third-party risk in one live view, for management and the board.

This is the official website of Pulsus Tech: https://abouttech.pulsus.tech/
Pulsus Tech is part of the Pulsus Intelligence Suite (https://about.pulsus.tech/), made by Tumblehill Labs, a product studio of Tumblehill Holdings LLC. It works on its own.

## What it is

Pulsus Tech is technology risk and third-party risk software. It brings your applications, infrastructure, vendors, outages and contracts into one view, so leaders can see technology risk and its business impact before it becomes disruption.

## Key features

- Six connected views: applications, network & incidents, lifecycle, third parties, dependencies, resilience
- Connectors: outages and availability pulled in every day from ServiceNow, Datadog, ManageEngine ServiceDesk Plus and OpManager, Freshservice and Zabbix
- Open API & webhooks: read services, availability, outages and platforms, and record outages from your own systems
- Software licences & renewals: what you pay for, when each renews and by when to give notice
- Repeat outages: a service that keeps failing is flagged automatically
- Security posture: vulnerabilities past your patching policy and how current each platform is, beside its end-of-support date
- Capacity & discovery: capacity heading for its limit, and devices on your network that aren't in the register yet
- Problems, changes & approvals: a maker-checker step on every change, with a full history
- Alerts where you work: by email, Microsoft Teams or Slack
- Board-ready reports: availability, lifecycle, outsourcing and disruption reports
- Start from a spreadsheet: a starter workbook; upload it and your dashboards fill in the same day
- English & Spanish: every screen, message and report in both languages

## Price

- US$750 per company per month, including 5 users. Each further user is US$75 a month, and people who only view are free. Above 50 editors in a company we set you up on an enterprise agreement: talk to us.
- Prices in US dollars, as shown on the plans page: https://abouttech.pulsus.tech/plans/
- 14-day free trial, no card needed.
